name: ForgeCoach pair scenery, pairs-v5
author: jalirkan
note: pairs-v5 (spec 1.16.1): pairs-v4's ten whole-half panoramas with the third colour painted in, sided: at stages 2 and 3, for each of the three other colours, the feature grown on the key's left colour's ground (`left`) and on its right colour's (`right`); the reader draws the heavier pair colour's side. Desktop files here; the element phone pictures at @pairs-v5-phone, the base phone panoramas at @pairs-v4, the halves and frames at @pairs-v2. Keys a+b alphabetical.

forest+island.place: jungle mounds standing in a turquoise primordial lagoon

forest+mountain.place: tall dark conifers climbing red volcanic slopes

forest+plains.place: golden grass with scattered broad trees and a bright horizon

forest+swamp.place: flooded cypress swamp, green water, hanging moss

island+mountain.place: a black volcanic island in a turquoise sea, lava meeting water in steam

island+plains.place: a frozen white plain meeting a cold blue sea, ice shelf and pale sky

island+swamp.place: a black cavern sea under a vaulted rock ceiling, bioluminescent water

mountain+plains.place: a high red-rock mesa under a wide bright sky, pale grass on top

mountain+swamp.place: cracked black earth and red rock, a dry scorched gorge with embers

plains+swamp.place: one broken pale shrine among the bleached stones on the dark peat moor
